Allegations of Nvidia Chip Smuggling Network Linked to China

Reports allege that Alice Huang, described as the public face of a network, was involved in smuggling Nvidia chips to China. Investigations suggest Huang was in contact with an officer from China's Ministry of State Security between spring and fall of an unspecified year, according to individuals familiar with intelligence reports. The network is also reportedly linked to Huang's husband and a data-center network backed by China. US intelligence agencies were reportedly aware of Huang's activities.
